keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks the Abdallab; the Funj dossier draws them as a vassal tint over the same land). The page has no area or boundary; it says only that after 1504 they "ruled over the Butana as vassals" and that the 1622 northern frontier was at Hannik, just north of Dongola. The drawn region repeats the Funj dossier's vassal region.

sources.title: Abdallab
sources.note: Late 15th-century rebellion against Alodia, defeat by the Funj near Arbaji in 1504, Ajib 1576, Karkoj 1611-12, frontier at Hannik 1622, capital moved to Halfayat al-Muluk, Egyptian conquest 1820-21. No infobox or area.

notes: New dossier: Cliopatria lacks the Abdallab. One page opened (Abdallab; budget 1-2). The page has no infobox: the start (late 15th century) is a placeholder at confidence 1, and the mid-18th-century capital move is undated. The Funj dossier (af-01-b) already records vassal_start 1504 and vassal_end 1821 for counterpart 'abdallab' over the same region; this dossier agrees with both years. Disagreement with af-01-a's suggestion (1474-1505 for 'Abdallab (Abdallah Jammah)'): no 1474 date appears on the page. Gazetteer names needed: Qarri (Kerreri, Nile between Khartoum and Shendi), Halfayat al-Muluk (Halfaya), Hannik, Butana (also requested by af-01-b); coordinates of both capitals are approximate. The counterpart for 1576-1622 is 'ottoman-empire' by my reading.
